A thin spoon gently stirs, withdraws, then a fresh red strawberry hooks onto the rim. Six distinct poses, keep the glass stationary. No whipped cream, no lid.

Crisp at small size. Keep camera angle, vessel silhouette, scale, handle orientation, horizontal center and bottom baseline identical across all six frames. Show a coherent repeated action with distinct moving tools, ingredients, liquid or steam; not shaking the whole image. Left-to-right then top-to-bottom temporal order.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No colored backdrop, floor, countertop, atmosphere, glow, shadows outside the object, cast background, cats, people, hands, text, letters, numbers, cell borders, watermarks or logos. Include only the named food, containers and utensils.
